name: 14152-sharegpt-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one engine, one model worker, one card.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads (GQA 4:1), head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params; KV 128 KiB per token.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=512, bounded at 4096 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion, leaving ~3072 measured requests.
workload: ShareGPT V3 conversational prompts, single turn, shipped as `configs/data/sharegpt-v3-llama31-4096.jsonl` (4096 rows, GuideLLM `json_file`, `request_format: plain`, so no chat template is applied). Prompt mean 221.8 tokens (p50 101, max 1021), output mean 200.2 (p50 134, max 1838), 422 tokens per row on average and 1925 at worst; GuideLLM sets `ignore_eos`, so every request emits exactly its row's completion length. The rows are distinct and their count matches the request bound, so no row is served twice into a warm prefix cache.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant on one H100, serving 512 concurrent users short conversational prompts with few-hundred-token replies.
launch:
# The engine command line. The V1 switch and the attention backend are not expressible here --
# this engine reads both only from the environment -- so they live in configs/tuned.yaml.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
# Must stay above the declared 512 streams, or the running batch is capped below the operating point.
max-num-seqs: 1024
# Explicit on purpose: built outside the OpenAI-server usage context this engine falls through to 2048.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
block-size: 16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-model-len: 4096
